translations.web: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
translations.bsb: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
translations.kjv: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
